items.text: haan ji
ji haan
mera number port karwana hai indore se bangalore
matlab mera sim replace karna hai kyu ki lost ho gaya hai
main Wednesday ko apply karna chahta tha nahi Thursday hoga
woh mera old sim activate karna tha abhi naya mila hai
thoda wait karna padega port hone mein kitna time lagega
maine last week request ki thi lekin ab tak process nahi hui
matlab mera number swap karwana hai do sim ke beech mein

items.context: aapka poora address kya hai port ke liye
items.text: haan mujhe port karwana hai mere paas detail hai
main khud sim lene aaya tha kal ke din

items.context: kya aap ek aur sim chahte hain apne number par
items.text: meri family ke liye ek sim or add karna hai
mera thoda jaldi kar do please Wednesday tak chahiye

items.context: kya aap port karenge ya sim replace karenge
items.text: wi-fi number pe port karna hai nahi to sim replace kar dena
mera sim kaafi der se kaam nahi kar raha hoon to naya port karwana hai mujhe thoda jaldi process kar do
main chahata hoon mera number swap kar doon apne do alag devices me lekin process samajh nahi aa raha
actually mera sim kharaab ho gaya tha to main replace karwana chahta hoon aur naya sim jaldi bhejo

items.text: agent aapne kab request ki thi port ke liye to mujhe confirm karna hai aapke hisab se kab hoga ye

items.text: kya mujhe naya sim khud center par le kar aana padega ya delivery ho sakti hai location par

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: port_or_sim - wants to port the number, replace or swap a SIM
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
